family: The fixed total norm-one language in family.md Section 1. Reject N<16 and invalid headers. Use its t,m and field E, parse the tm-bit payload z, ignore the tail and accept iff z^(sum_(j<t)2^(mj))=1. The witness is empty.
theorem: At every sufficiently large integer actual input length N the fixed norm-one language has full-B2 circuit complexity at least (2413957989/500000000)N, with zero explicit remainder, unrestricted sharing and repeated pins.
